run_extract_instance_images_cli: run the CLI tool to extract ScanNet 2D instance and label zip files from scan directories
run_batch_export_scannet: run batch_export to unzip 2D instance and label data for multiple ScanNet scans in parallel
run_export_one_scan: run export_one_scan to unzip 2D instance and label zip files for a single ScanNet scan
refactor_batch_export_nproc: refactor batch_export to adjust the number of parallel processes used for ScanNet data extraction
review_export_one_scan_unzip: review export_one_scan to understand how it unzips 2D instance and label files for a ScanNet scan
